text: ETF 的种类太多了，你只说了一种，就想把问题搞清，从税务角度看，有K1公司报税一类的ETF，有背后是美国国债一类的ETF，dividend免州税，还有一些是以操作期货的ETF，分红符合section 1256 报税规则，房地产的ETF，报税可以用199A 的20%减免。
Target date funds 合适90％的人

Nowadays there are usually many ETFs for every sector of investment. So, if my portfolio calls for one specific type/sector of investment to allocate against, I can usually find one or more corresponding ETFs to include, regardless of my target - taxable, IRA, ROTH, 401K, etc.  So the real question should be how to minimize my taxes when I retire, ETF or else. Look forward to your further guidance on that.
